title: Candidate retention
purpose: Define bounded local selection, retention, and verification for one source-built synthetic candidate without rebuilding or external actions.

entryEvidence.observation: The compiled synthetic policy identifies one disabled source, policy epoch, release identity, and bounded operating envelope.
The aggregate operations projection classifies the selected synthetic application available before local retention.
One source-built synthetic artifact has exact file, byte, digest, policy, and release identities.

boundedActions.instruction: Record the source, policy, release, artifact, map, and approved rollback identities once.
Verify the selected source-built artifact, checksums, bounded policy limits, and synthetic-only classification once.
Request separate approval for the exact local candidate path and selected identities before retention begins.
Verify one aggregate synthetic retention receipt against the selected candidate identity without rebuilding.

stopConditions.observation: Stop if any source, policy, release, artifact, map, rollback, checksum, or receipt identity is absent or inconsistent.
Stop as ready for a receipt only when the unchanged synthetic candidate and aggregate operations state both verify.

rollbackActions.instruction: Keep the selected source-built bytes and last approved release unchanged if local retention verification fails.
